item.tib: gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po'i rgyud las gsol 'debs yon tan kun 'byung
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yi/ gsol 'debs dag la bstan nas su/ mchog thun dngos grub zhu thabs 'di/ ma sring thugs kyi bcud yin gsungs/ ma nges sprang po rnal 'byor gyi (gyis/)(dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen (mchan) )ma sring zhal gyis gdams pa'i bon/ zang 'brug 'khyil ba'i ri bo ru/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ mkha' 'gro gnyan la bzod par gsol/ dar rgyas 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog/
